title: Scallop Aquaculture Internship
detail: Contributed to scallop (hotate) aquaculture operations at Kanemi Shibutasuisan Co., Ltd. in Hokkaido, Japan. Focused on cultivation processes and the development and maintenance of marine equipment.

title: Marine Plastic Waste Tracker
detail: Designed and developed an IoT-based marine plastic waste tracking prototype. Utilizes MQTT communication for reliable, real-time data transmission to monitor and map aquatic environments effectively.

title: Real-Time Tracking Dashboard
detail: Developed a real-time web dashboard to visualize data from the marine plastic waste tracker. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Node.js, and integrated with a Mosquitto MQTT Broker for live data streaming.

title: Marine Instrumentation
detail: Teaching Assistant for Marine Instrumentation. Facilitate laboratory sessions and learning activities focused on Internet of Things (IoT) applications, sensor integration, and practical marine technology.

title: Media & Communication Coordinator
detail: Media & Communication Coordinator for OPIK UNSOED 2024. Managed organizational communication, media relations, and documentation, complementing technical expertise with strong leadership and coordination skills.
